lines.1: A fresh morning on the way to school.
lines.2: Kinu never gets up easily, so I left her behind.
lines.3: Around here was where familiar faces usually started showing up...
lines.8: 「You're tall. Keep slouching like that and you'll bend your spine.」
lines.10: 「Were you up studying for the tests or something?」
lines.11: 「Oh... finals start next week, don't they?」
lines.13: 「I was busy helping the drama club.」
lines.14: I tried saying it as pointedly as possible.
lines.15: 「Idiot. Everybody was busy. That's no excuse. There--perfectly sound argument.」
lines.17: 「You were never all that smart to begin with.」
lines.18: 「Well, do your best not to fail anything. Ahaha.」
lines.19: 「You're kind of annoying, you know that?」
lines.20: 「If it bothers you, try beating me.」
lines.21: 「You were around twentieth in the grade, weren't you?」
lines.23: 「Pathetic. At least say something like, 'I'm gonna DO it!!'」
lines.24: 「Unlike you, I don't rise to every little provocation.」
lines.26: 「Meaning: the first thing today that got on my nerves.」
lines.28: Even with the drama-club job over, we'd started greeting each other naturally.
lines.29: You could say our relationship had completely gone back to normal.
